Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence

Class UnidadDAO

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.persistence.UnidadDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
CRUDOperation<UnidadDTO>
public class UnidadDAO extends Object implements CRUDOperation<UnidadDTO>
The UnidadDAO class manages CRUD operations for UnidadDTO objects. It uses the custom data structure MyLinkedList to store and manipulate units. Main methods: - create(UnidadDTO): Adds a new unit to the list of units. - update(int, UnidadDTO): Updates an existing unit identified by its index. - delete(int): Removes a unit from the list based on its index. - findOne(int): Searches for and returns a specific unit by its index.
